imagery_style: Real people, authentic before/afters, diverse (25-70 age range). Warm lighting, no stock clichés. Color grading: warm saturation on skin tones, complements blue+teal palette. Layout: clean, spacious, medical authority without coldness.
iconography: Minimal stroke-based icons (Feather/Lucide style, modified). Rounded corners, 2px consistent stroke. Energy bolt (green #34C759), leaf (teal #20B2AA), checkmark & shield (blue #0066CC).
